markets: Greater Houston (21 communities incl. Katy, Magnolia, Rosenberg, Cypress, Tomball area)
profile.org_note: Texas limited partnership whose general partner is L.L. Manager, L.L.C., managed by Roger B. Medors; land is bought and developed by the sister partnership Woodmere Development Co., Ltd. (GP Woodmere GP, LLC, same manager, same Katy Fwy office), led by President Richard Rue. CEO Craig Jones per Builder and The Real Deal. Single-market Houston builder, so no divisions. The orchestrator's lead brands (Anglia, Brighton, Princeton Classic, Briarwood, Kendall Homes) are not Long Lake brands: the company sells only as Long Lake ('Briarwood' is one of its four model series), and Anglia Homes, LP has a different general partner and address in state records.
profile.summary: Houston's self-described largest privately owned homebuilder, building since 1997 (30,000+ homes delivered), now in 21 Greater Houston communities priced about $287K-$628K, entry-level and move-up. It develops much of its own land through affiliate Woodmere Development (494 acres near Bridgeland/Katy in 2022, 95 acres near Tomball in 2024) and also buys lots in third-party master plans such as Beacon Hill and Sunterra. Closings have fallen from 943 (2023) to 912 (2024) to 782 (2025, per the 2026 Builder 100 lead).
